item.description:
Email: Floratina_Sounds@outlook.com
Profile: LinkedIn | GitHubMA Capstone Project | Department of English, CityUHK | Jan 2026 - April 2026 Individual Critical Survey: “Purity and Agency: A Study of the “Struggle for Recognition” in Tess of the d’Urbervilles” Project Title: “Awakening Agency: Women’s Self-Growth in Nineteenth-Century Novels” Supervisor: Dr. Jeffrey Lang Mather | Grade Received: A (27/30) Synthesized Rousseau’s concept of “natural authenticity,” Hegel’s master-slave dialectic, Fukuyama’s “last man,” and C.S. Lewis’s “men without chests” to analyze the tragic agency of Hardy’s protagonist. Explored how Tess, under Victorian societal oppression, transitions from a child of nature to an alienated subject, reclaiming her agency against modernity. Conducted extensive literature reviews, academic writing, and critical discourse analysis. Collaborated with team members to structure the research paper, present findings, and synthesize critical theory.
Website: https://fhetract.wixsite.com/group5 Mandarin (Native) | English Critical discourse analysis Literary theory application Library databases searching (JSTOR, MLA International Bibliography, Project MUSE) Academic referencing (MLA, APA). Proficient in AI-assisted programming: successfully developed a Python script utilizing yt-dlp to batch-scrape YouTube comments and format them into structured JSON/CSV datasets for sociolinguistic research, with a WebUI for reviewing and processing data (applied in EN5461 Language in Its Social Context). Currently self-learning Tauri and React UI for frontend application development. Advanced practitioner of prompt engineering; Established a structured workflow for literature mapping, literature searching, and source cross-verification using LLMs (Gemini, ChatGPT and their APIs), AI-powered platforms and Agents (NotebookLM, Microsoft Copilot). Understanding of Large Language Model mechanics, including temperature, Top-P, attention mechanisms, context window management, and function calling to optimize research boundaries and minimize hallucinations. Editing & Knowledge Management: Advanced document layout and formatting in MS Word; proficient in Markdown editing and personal knowledge management via Obsidian and Zotero. Audio Engineering (Personal Interest): Skilled in audio mixing, sound design, and basic acoustics (using Ableton Live); currently studying music theory. © 2026 Floratina
